summary: Completed comprehensive testing of NEW Summer Spin & Win Giveaway feature. All 58 backend tests passed (100%), including 15 new giveaway tests. Frontend testing verified all giveaway features work correctly: Dashboard Giveaway tab with activate/deactivate toggle, settings form, entries list; Public site Spin & Win button visibility based on active state; Spin wheel modal with 8 prize segments, form fields, and prize result display.
seed_data_creation: Test giveaway entries created during testing (test_spin_*, test_claim_*, test_dup_*, test_ui_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All giveaway features working correctly: 1) GET /api/giveaway/settings returns settings with is_active, title, subtitle, start_date, end_date, prizes array (8 prizes), 2) PUT /api/giveaway/settings with auth can toggle is_active, update title/subtitle/dates/prizes, 3) POST /api/giveaway/spin returns 400 when inactive, returns prize when active, returns already_entered:true for duplicate email, 4) GET /api/giveaway/entries with auth returns entries list with id, name, email, prize, claimed, entered_at, 5) PUT /api/giveaway/entries/{id}/claim marks entry as claimed, 6) GET /api/giveaway/winners returns recent winners excluding Try Again, 7) Dashboard Giveaway tab shows activate/deactivate toggle, settings form with title/subtitle/dates/prizes, entries list with Claimed buttons, 8) Public site shows Spin & Win button ONLY when giveaway is active, 9) Spin modal shows wheel with 8 prize segments (canvas-drawn), form fields (name, email, phone), SPIN THE WHEEL button, 10) After spin: wheel animates, lands on prize, shows Congratulations with prize and redemption info. Previous features continue to work: login, analytics, specials, CMS content/menu editing, catering inquiries, newsletter subscribers.
